answer: Sanofi's statutory auditors expressed limited assurance over the 2025 sustainability information in sections 3.1–3.5 and the Article 8 EU Taxonomy information. Their three conclusions were that they identified no material errors, omissions or inconsistencies in (1) the ESRS process used to determine reportable information, (2) the sustainability information's compliance with French law including ESRS, and (3) Article 8 reporting. The work followed French law and H2A limited-assurance guidelines. It excluded 2023 comparatives; limited assurance uses less extensive procedures than reasonable assurance; forward-looking outcomes are inherently uncertain; and it does not guarantee management quality or assess the relevance of action plans, targets, policies, scenarios or transition plans.
